scope: Only the necessary new window precontact gate; previous cross-object checks remain historical evidence. Synthetic fixtures are TEST_FIXTURE_ONLY and cannot certify a runtime.

windowEvidenceRetention.reviewed: Workbench deep-copies each completed open, close and other window case; the verifier selects the case copy by taskToken, with no window-array-length cursor.
windowEvidenceRetention.additionalApproachRows: At about 1.8 seconds, around 20 approach rows including its segment boundary plus the prior maximum of 26 gives about 46 rows per task, well below 256; this is a source-based estimate, not a new browser measurement.
windowEvidenceRetention.boundary: The final rolling world snapshot can omit older tasks; their completed case copies remain in verification. Missing required stages still fail.
